name: essensys
positioning: The infrastructure layer under flex space — network, access and billing for buildings running many operators.
description: essensys provides software and on-site technology for flexible workspace: operations and billing platform, plus network infrastructure that segments and provisions connectivity per tenant, and access control across multi-tenant buildings.
real_estate_use: A landlord converting floors to flex has a problem no coworking app solves: every occupier needs its own secure network segment, provisioned in hours rather than weeks, and metered. essensys sits at that layer, which is why it is bought by landlords and large operators rather than by single spaces.
features: Automated billing for space, services and consumption
Operations platform for flexible workspace portfolios

use_cases.job: Turn floors into flex space with secure per-occupier networks provisioned in hours
Meter and bill services consumed by multiple operators in one building
